rules.name: broken-ref
rules.description: Broken/circular references and unknown component sub-tokens.

rules.name: missing-primary
rules.description: Missing primary color — warns when colors are defined but no 'primary' exists.

rules.name: contrast-ratio
rules.description: WCAG contrast ratio — warns when component backgroundColor/textColor pairs fall below the AA minimum of 4.5:1.

rules.name: orphaned-tokens
rules.description: Orphaned tokens — tokens defined but never referenced by any component.

rules.name: token-summary
rules.description: Token count summary — emits an info diagnostic summarizing how many tokens are defined.

rules.name: missing-sections
rules.description: Missing sections — notes when optional sections (spacing, rounded) are absent.

rules.name: missing-typography
rules.description: Missing typography — warns when colors are defined but no typography tokens exist.

rules.name: section-order
rules.description: Section order — warns when sections are out of canonical order.

rules.name: unknown-key
rules.description: Unknown key — warns when a top-level YAML key looks like a typo of a known schema key.

rules.name: token-like-ignored
rules.description: Warns when a top-level YAML key looks like a design-token map but is not part of the recognized export schema and will be silently ignored.

rules.name: omitted-rules
rules.description: Validates omitted sections and alerts on redundant or unknown entries.
